dialogue_texts: Kaguya
Yumemura... a village that seems to have forgotten how to wake up.
Kaguya
Is this the manor where the air has turned so stagnant?
Kaguya
It lacks the elegance I expect from a world-ending threat.
A guest who speaks of elegance? How unrefined. But you won't find any moonlit paths to hide in here.
Kaguya
Hiding is for those who fear the passage of time.
Kaguya
For an immortal, a moonlit path is simply wherever I choose to walk.
Saika
You talk big for a Lunarian exile. I am Saika Tatsumaru.
Saika
My "serpentine flame" purifies the uninvited, especially those who think they can boss around the People's Kingdom.
Kaguya
Purify? How quaint. I've seen stars born and die, little snake.
Kaguya
Your fire is but a flicker in the dark of my eternity.
Saika
Then let's see if that "eternity" can withstand the heat! This manor is Order territory.
Saika
If you won't leave, you'll be reduced to ash before the next moonrise!
Kaguya
Very well. If you insist on entertaining me...
Kaguya
I suppose I can spare a few minutes of my endless life to watch you burn out.
